directive.quote: Claim only honest existing-source ports JSON for the local model router.

job: Route a model request to an available local model and report models that fit the current computer.

targets.baseline_commit_message: Move old trillion's local-model tools into models-on-this-computer

preserve: Try configured local models in order and record which model answered or why each was passed over.
Treat request-shape refusals separately from server unavailability so one unsupported request does not silence other asks.
Ask classifiers locally and keep the conversation or state on the person's computer.
Offer models according to the computer's reported hardware and available storage.
allowed_deltas: Model tables and endpoints are read from Workshop-owned DATA instead of the old account refresh and local copy.
The program runs through the Workshop records-door computer export.
This process reads its computer hardware and free space directly.
Old model installer, managed-profile reader, other-computer endpoints, and per-process fast-path meter are omitted because this runtime does not provide those capabilities.
banned_substitutions: Do not send local model request text to a hosted model as a fallback.
Do not add a model, endpoint, or person-specific policy to executable code.
